fullExplanation.text: Understanding Baruch in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life

Baruch provides the larger frame for Baruch in Christ, the Church, Liturgy, and Christian Life. An independent Catholic study of Baruch focused on exile, repentance, wisdom, consolation, and Jerusalem. Catholic method here moves from the inspired text to doctrinal judgment while also examining reception and reasoned scholarship.
